lead.text:
Demeter :aomr_demeter_icon: gives you many defensive and economic options. So first validate who you are facing: 

• If you encounter an aggressive one: go for defense and train your troops. 
• If you find another economic or passive one: do <highlight-pink>Bread Pioneers</highlight-pink> :aomr_pans_pioneers_icon: and 2nd TC :aomr_town_center_icon:

It is possible to go with Kataskopos to the enemy base and use the <highlight-purple>Secar</highlight-purple> :aomr_wither_icon: power in his forest. 

This will give you a small advantage of his delivery time and resource. Works best against Greeks, Chinese, Japanese and Aztecs. In the case of Egyptians, Norse and Atlanteans, it makes no difference. So it can also be used on :aomr_farm_icon: farms later.

table.description: Rebalance Villagers immediately <highlight-gray>(in gold and temple)</highlight-gray>
Pastables :aomr_cow_icon::aomr_goat_icon::aomr_pig_icon: near the Temple to increase favor (:aomr_demeter_icon:)
Train +2 Lycaon :aomr_lykaon_icon: (trained in the Temple) and put what was born in the chickens :aomr_chicken_icon:
Other villagers that are born, place them on wood
OPTIONS) Go up to the Military Academy and Archer Camp and train troops

footer.text: After passing Age, the game becomes very adaptable.
In this case, it is good to have <highlight-pink>vision</highlight-pink> :los_icon_aoe3de: of the <highlight-red>Adversary</highlight-red> and observe his next steps!
Find out if it is reliable to do the 2nd TC :aomr_town_center_egyptian_icon: or fight Classic with army from the Quarteis
Typically, most opponents <highlight-red>raidam</highlight-red> or <highlight-red>aggressive</highlight-red> early on.

So it is an option to use the Gold that would go to TC in <highlight-gray>soldados</highlight-gray> :aomr_axeman_icon: :aomr_spearman_icon: or even more <highlight-teal>Sarcedotes</highlight-teal> to hold MUs :aomr_type_myth_unit_icon: !

See below for some strategy tips ↓

footer.text: Strategy (Aggressive Heroic)
If proceeding through Ptah:
1. Use <highlight-purple>Vision</highlight-purple> :aomr_vision_icon: +<highlight-purple>Moving Areas</highlight-purple> :aomr_shifting_sands_icon: to teleport Pharaoh + Workers to advanced mine.
1. Build Migdol Fortress + Siege Engines.
1. Build 1 Monument next to the Fortress.
Production:
Spamar Camelo :aomr_camel_rider_icon: , Biga :aomr_yumi_horse_archer_icon: , Elefante :aomr_war_elephant_icon: e Caixa.
Start pulling the enemy base.
Combate:
If the enemy has an army, the ideal is to fight under your Migdol Fortress.
Power usage:
Ancestors can be used to:
1. Disrupt the economy and facilitate advanced Migdol, or
1. Save for the main attack.
Observations
Sarcerdote inicial + macaco + animais convertidos devem abrir o mapa.
Build recommended against players who experience an economic boom, mainly:
1. Egyptians :aomr_egyptians_icon: or civs like Thor, Hades and Gaia.
1. Especially if the opponent does second TC :aomr_town_center_greek_icon: .
Texto corrido
